title: Objectwise injective-resolution cohomology comparison
statement: For an injective resolution I of F, there are objectwise isomorphisms from the homology of the evaluated complex to the cohomology presheaf, compatible with every restriction morphism.

proof.text: Construct the comparison using sheafification and free abelian representable adjunctions, then identify the induced Hom complexes and Ext homology objectwise; naturality in restriction maps gives compatibility.

mathlib_searches.query: natural isomorphism from objectwise isomorphisms compatibility homology functor

mathlib_searches.results: NatIso.ofComponents found but does not prove objectwise comparison
